title: EvoSyn：通过演化生成空间实现闭环学习的智能体数据合成
summary: 论文提出EvoSyn，一个由学习反馈驱动的多智能体框架，围绕可修订状态组织合成过程，明确可生成的交互因素及合成资源分配。通过角色分工的多智能体系统将学习者反馈转化为合成修订，实现空间内适应与合成空间扩展。在τ²-Bench和CAR-Bench上平均任务成功率提升13.3个百分点。
summary_en: The paper proposes EvoSyn, a learning-feedback-driven multi-agent framework that organizes synthesis around a revisable state specifying what interaction factors can be generated and where synthesis effort should be allocated. A role-specialized multi-agent system translates learner feedback into synthesis revisions, enabling within-space adaptation and synthesis-space expansion. Experiments on τ²-Bench and CAR-Bench show a 13.3-point average task success improvement over the strongest baseline.
